title: Project spine template, publish capability and shared shell sources released
summary: Project OS 0.4.1 adds the requested repository spine through its collision-preserving installer and is marked as a GitHub template. Skills Hub publishes the tested static publish capability, and the Library registers the shared shell with explicit pending licensing.
intent: Make each project easier to start, find, publish and resume from durable repositories and URLs.
reasoning: The existing Project OS installer already owns template materialization, adoption and upgrades; adding the spine there preserves existing owner state and avoids a second installer.
The existing v0.5.0 fleet-pack tag is a separate published line absent from canonical main. The spine is released as v0.4.1 and the fleet tag remains untouched.
Publish source was recovered byte-for-byte from its frozen pilot, then amended in a separate commit to bound aggregate memory and validate the actual handoff destination before deploying.
The Library selects source releases independently from the immutable Agent Stack Assembly and separately pinned Stack Distribution installer.
The shell is registered with pending redistribution licensing, matching its source documentation rather than inventing a reuse grant.

changes.summary: Versioned repository spine, schema checks, adoption preservation and template documentation.
Publish 0.1.1 with exact readback, caller handoff receipt and bounded memory.
Shared shell identity and rights boundary.
V39 replaces two selected releases and adds the shell, preserving the remaining view.

evidence.summary: 46 tests pass; self-check validates 42 schemas; greenfield and existing migration smokes pass. A fresh npx install from public v0.4.1 created the front door and passed project check. Full suite peak RSS 248528896 bytes under a two-billion-byte process-group guard.
Public canonical main matches the released commit and GitHub is_template is true. GitHub templating copies the kit; the documented installer materializes a configured project.
33 canonical skills validate; publish boundary and aggregate-memory tests pass; official installation matches source. Pilot 0.1.0 is preserved at 7cf036a.

next_actions: Add the gls register capability over the existing schemas and verification gate.
Extend the reading surfaces and public sections using authored, publication-safe source records.
